BiblicalUsage: Anani is named once, at the end of the genealogy of David's line: the sons of Elioenai were Hodaiah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Dalaiah, and Anani, seven. He is the last name in a long line of David's descendants, counted among the sons of the kingdom after the exile.
TheologicalSignificance: A name at the end of a genealogy still counts: Anani is one of the seven sons who carried David's line forward after the exile, and the list remembers him for it.
